claims.claim: Cache hit health metric is cache_read_input_tokens / (cache_read + cache_creation + input_tokens), with >80% being healthy
claims.citation: cache_hit_ratio = cache_read_input_tokens / (cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + input_tokens). Zdrowa multi-turn konwersacja: >80%. Claude Code sessions: 96%.

claims.claim: Cache hit ratio below 50% for 3+ consecutive requests indicates alertable anomaly requiring investigation
claims.citation: Spadek ponizej 50% przez 3+ requestow = alert (cos invalidates).

claims.claim: API response.usage contains 4 cache-specific fields: input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and cache_creation (TTL breakdown)
claims.citation: Kazda odpowiedz Anthropic API zawiera `usage` obiekt... 4 pola: input_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cache_creation

claims.claim: Cache read tokens cost 0.1x base rate, cache creation costs 1.25x (5m) or 2x (1h), uncached tokens cost base rate
claims.citation: input_tokens * base_rate + cache_read_input_tokens * base_rate * 0.1 + cache_creation * base_rate * 1.25 (5m) or 2.0 (1h)

claims.claim: Typical Claude Code sessions achieve 96% cache hit ratio with system prompt + tools + CLAUDE.md (~18k tokens)
claims.citation: Claude Code session (96% obserwowane). Anthropic internal data: $50-100 per session pre-cache, $10-19 post-cache (80% savings)
claims.source_location: section: Cache hit ratio table (2.1) and Case 2 (4.2)

claims.claim: Du'An Lightfoot case: YouTube analytics bot saved $720/month to $72/month (90% reduction) with 81k-token static system prompt
claims.citation: System prompt: 81,251 tokens. Pre-cache: $0.244/request = $720/month. Post-cache (5m TTL): $0.024/request = $72/month.

claims.claim: Haiku 4.5 support ticket processing at scale achieves $37 per 10,000 tickets with Batch + Cache stacking
claims.citation: Haiku 4.5 support ticket processing: $37 per 10,000 tickets (~$0.0037 per ticket).

claims.claim: Team scaling case: solo developer $202/year -> $27/year (86% reduction); 20-dev team $12,120/year -> $1,920/year (84% reduction)
claims.citation: Solo developer: $202/y -> $27/y (86% reduction). Team 20 devs: $12,120/y -> $1,920/y (84% reduction).

claims.claim: flightlesstux/prompt-caching MCP plugin benchmarks show 80-92% savings across bug fix, refactor, and general coding sessions
claims.citation: Bug fix (20 turns): 85% savings. Refactor (15 turns): 80%. General coding (40 turns): 92%.

claims.claim: masorange/ClaudeUsageTracker real session snapshot: 155.6M cache_read vs 12.4M cache_creation (12.6:1 ratio) = 92.8% hit rate
claims.citation: Cache creation: 12,367,742 tokens. Cache read: 155,606,800 tokens. Stosunek: 12.6:1. Cache hit rate = 92.8%.

claims.claim: TTL regression incident (March 2026) cost one developer $949 on Sonnet and $1,582 on Opus across 4 months (119,866 calls)
claims.citation: Sonnet 4.6: $5,561.17 actual vs $4,612.09 z 1h TTL = $949 overpaid. Opus 4.6: $9,268.97 actual vs $7,687.17 z 1h TTL = $1,582 overpaid. Total: $2,531 in 4 months.

claims.claim: Anthropic Console displays cache rate % aggregate but does NOT export raw cache_read_input_tokens field per request
claims.citation: Oficjalny dashboard - sekcja Rate Limit Use + Caching wyswietla Cache rate %, ITPM limit. Brak eksportu raw cache_read_input_tokens.

claims.claim: Claude Code Analytics Admin API provides per-user, per-model, per-day granular cache metrics (cache_read + cache_creation)
claims.citation: Enterprise/Org API z programmatic access: tokens.cache_read + tokens.cache_creation. Granulacja: per dzien, per user, per model.
claims.source_location: section: Claude Code Analytics Admin API (9.2)

claims.claim: Honeycomb offers enterprise observability with anthropic.usage.cache_read_input_tokens gauge and minute-level granularity
claims.citation: metrika anthropic.usage.cache_read_input_tokens jako gauge w timeline. Minute-level granularity per API key / workspace / model.

claims.claim: Datadog integration provides anthropic.cache_read_input_tokens gauge but lacks pre-built alert templates for cache anomalies
claims.citation: Gauge metric anthropic.cache_read_input_tokens. Cloud Cost Management integration. Limitation: brak pre-built alert templates.

claims.claim: Sealos/Grafana PromQL stack enables production-ready cache hit rate visualization via OpenTelemetry + Prometheus
claims.citation: PromQL: sum(cache_read) / (sum(cache_read) + sum(input)) * 100. 3-section dashboard: Vital Signs / Efficiency / Trends.

claims.claim: Spring AI (Java) exposes cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens natively via AnthropicApi.Usage since October 2025
claims.citation: AnthropicApi.Usage: cacheReadInputTokens() + cacheCreationInputTokens(). Production-ready Oct 2025.

claims.claim: OpenTelemetry double-counting bug: pydantic-ai + Langfuse falsify costs by adding input_tokens twice (Anthropic vs OTel semantics mismatch)
claims.citation: OpenTelemetry semantic convention: gen_ai.usage.input_tokens = suma wszystkich. Anthropic API input_tokens = uncached only. Frameworks double-count.

claims.claim: Luong Nguyen bisection methodology: Remove half of system prompt, test; isolate single cache invalidation trigger in CLAUDE.md edits
claims.citation: Metodologia: Bisekcja, usuwamy polowe CLAUDE.md, testujemy; potem druga polowe. Root cause: pojedyncza linia w CLAUDE.md.

claims.claim: Cache invalidation events taxonomy: model switch, MCP tool add/remove, CLAUDE.md edit, timestamp in static, capitalization drift, TTL expire, compact/clear
claims.citation: Gdy ratio spada, szukaj: Model switch, MCP tool add, CLAUDE.md edit, timestamp, capitalization, TTL expire, compact/clear.

claims.claim: Alex Volkov Max Plan case: quota exhaustion in 70 minutes vs normal 8 hours caused by cache invalidation bugs (10-20x cost spike)
claims.citation: Max Plan user: 100% quota exhaustion w 70 minut zamiast 8 godzin. Tokens placone regular rate (10-20x drozsze niz cached).

claims.claim: Vercel AI SDK v4.0.31 does NOT expose cache_read_input_tokens to response (Issue #4335 closed without fix documentation)
claims.citation: Vercel AI SDK (v4.0.x) nie przekazuje cache_read_input_tokens do response. Issue #4335 zamkniety bez dokumentacji fixa.

claims.claim: Portkey AI Gateway normalizes cache_read to OpenAI-compatible prompt_tokens, potentially masking true cached token cost
claims.citation: Portkey normalizuje cache_read do OpenAI format, gdzie prompt_tokens = inputTokens + cache_read + cache_creation. Moze zaciemniac prawdziwy koszt.

claims.claim: GitHub Issue #33978 requests built-in 'claude usage' command; raw data exists in ~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl but requires parsing script
claims.citation: Feature request: built-in claude usage command. Data dostepne w JSONL plikach, ale wymagaja parsowania skryptem.

claims.claim: Community sentiment March-April 2026: negative on Anthropic post-TTL regression, but 90% savings broadly normalized as expected feature
claims.citation: Negatywny wobec Anthropic po TTL regression. Ale developerzy akceptuja 90% savings jako normal. Anthropic 1h TTL announcement dobrze przyjety.

claims.claim: bokonon23/clawdbot-cost-monitor, sstklen/claude-api-cost-optimization, sagargupta16/claude-cost-optimizer are production-grade open-source monitoring tools
claims.citation: Community dashboards (bokonon23, sstklen, sagargupta16) oferuja gotowe rozwiazania do live monitoring.

claims.claim: tokenx Python library provides cost monitoring decorators with Anthropic cache support (cacheTokens + calculated cost_usd)
claims.citation: tokenx: @measure_cost decorator. metrics['cached_tokens'] = cache_read_input_tokens. metrics['cost_usd'] = calculated with cache rates.

claims.claim: Minimum viable monitoring: log cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens per request, calculate ratio, alert <50%
claims.citation: Minimalny monitoring: loguj cache_read_input_tokens i cache_creation_input_tokens per request. Oblicz ratio. Alert <50%.

claims.claim: Batch API without priming achieves 30-70% cache hit ratio; with priming achieves 95-98%; first request always 0% (all cache_creation)
claims.citation: Batch API bez priming: 30-70%. Batch API + priming: 95-98%. Pierwszy request: 0% (wszystko to cache_creation).
claims.source_location: section: Cache hit ratio benchmarks table (2.1)

claims.claim: Default TTL changed from 1 hour to 5 minutes post-March 2026, causing outdated tutorials and developer confusion about cache lifetime
claims.citation: Po marcu 2026 default to 5m (przed: 1h). Tutoriale nie sa zaktualizowane - powoduje confusion u nowych developerow.

gaps_flagged: Gap 21: Anthropic Console brak raw cache_read_input_tokens export - only % aggregate. Claude Code Analytics API wymaga Admin API key (enterprise only). Individual developers bez dedicated monitoring solution.
Gap 22: New Relic/PagerDuty brak oficjalnych integracji z Anthropic cache metrics. Tylko Datadog + Honeycomb mają vendor support.
Gap 23: Brak SLA dla cache availability. Jeśli cache system spadnie, API działa ale placisz full rate - undocumented degradation.
Gap 24: Vercel AI SDK v4.0.x nie eksponuje cache_read_input_tokens w response. Issue #4335 zamkniety bez fixa - developers mogą nie wiedzieć czy cache działa.
Gap 25: OTel double-counting bug w pydantic-ai + Langfuse niezalatany. Framework developers mogą mieć 2x zafalszone koszty w raportach.
Gap 26: Brak built-in 'claude usage' command w Claude Code. Dane w JSONL są dostępne ale wymagają parsowania. Feature request #33978 open.
conflicts_flagged: Konflikt 15: Anthropic (The Register) zaprzecza TTL regression spowodowało quota drain. Community (GitHub #46829) twierdzi przeciwnie z danymi ($949+$1582 overpaid). Rozstrzygniecie: TTL była JEDNA z 3+ przyczyn - Anthropic zamknelo issue bez odpowiedzi.
Konflikt 16: Marketing artykuły podają '100x cheaper cache reads'. Faktycznie 10x (0.1x). 100x to exaggeration.

Konflikt 17: OTel spec mówi gen_ai.usage.input_tokens = suma wszystkich. Anthropic API input_tokens = tylko uncached. Wiele frameworków (pydantic-ai, langfuse) implementuje roznie - double-counting. Potwierdzono w Langfuse #12306 i pydantic-ai #4364.
Konflikt 18: Portkey normalizuje cache_read do OpenAI prompt_tokens format. Może liczyć cached tokens po full rate jeśli client używa OpenAI-compatible calculator.
Konflikt 19: TTL default zmienił się 1h (pre-Mar 2026) -> 5m (post-Mar 2026). Starsze tutoriale opisują 1h jako default - confusion u nowych developerów.
